'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello, warrior. How are things on the front line? People say you're a good shot, I've even tested you myself too. But what if you have to use a grenade? You will need intuition and brains to not get flogged accidently. So, I want to see how you handle grenades, go make some noise in Tarkov.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 10 to start this quest.
* Obtain level 2 loyalty with [[Prapor]].

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 5 of any target with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|grenades]] or [[Weapons#Grenade launchers|grenade launchers]]

==Rewards==
* +10,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.25'''</font>
* 165,000 Roubles
** ???,??? Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 192,967 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Good, limbs are still attached, and the needed noise has been made. You'll be useful in these matters then, warrior. Here's the reward, you earned it.}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 5 of any target with [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|grenades]]. 

[[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|Underbarrel grenade launchers]], [[Weapons#Grenade launchers|grenade launchers]] can be used, however [[Weapons#Rocket launchers|rocket launchers]] can '''not''' be used.
